calibration.dimension_source: A2.03, Level R1 Plan & RCP, uploaded page 1, 04-02-07
calibration.elevation_source: A3.11, building sections 01 and 02, uploaded page 9, 04-02-07
calibration.method: Transfer dimensioned common structural grid from A2.03 to P2.02; register the P4.01 Unit A crop to P2.02 using shared architectural features. A2.03 is not Unit A's architectural plan.
calibration.uncertainty_basis: Conservative working allowances for raster line picking, cross-sheet registration and simplified manual route tracing; not survey accuracy or statistical confidence limits.
calibration.roof_note: 404.42 is a top-of-plate reference, not a uniform roof surface. A3.11 also shows 406.00, 406.58 and 413.17 at other locations.
calibration.elevation_note: Use the explicitly labeled floor elevations. Some vertical interval notes add (+1/4 inch), which is not represented by the decimal elevation differences; retain this discrepancy pending architectural clarification.
calibration.ceiling_note: Eleven feet is floor-to-floor, not clear ceiling height. The new excerpt lacks the P1 unit plan, unit reflected-ceiling plan and explicit water-pipe elevations.

bathroom_pilot.scope: Primary bathroom domestic-water supplies only; drainage and venting are not included.
bathroom_pilot.hardware_basis: Elbows, tees, flexible connector dimensions, five stops and two mixer bodies are representative; not a manufacturer schedule or verified installed assembly.

limitations: Domestic water only. Sanitary, vent, gas, fire protection and architectural building geometry are not modeled.

Unit 107 XY is provisionally calibrated through the shared structural grid; building floor datums are documented. Pipe heights, building stack XY, fittings and equipment envelopes remain assumed. This is not an as-built or fully coordinated model.
A3.11 establishes 11 ft floor-to-floor at Unit 107, not clear ceiling height. Its (+1/4 in) interval notes conflict slightly with labeled elevation differences; model uses the labeled elevations.
Nominal bore is used as outside visual diameter; pipe material, wall thickness, insulation and actual OD are not established. No pipe lengths or quantities should be taken from this model.
Building stack positions are arranged for presentation. Typical unit branches terminate at continuations; their diameters are assumed pending unit-specific takeoff.
04 stack has four explicit upper branch groups on P3.02; its R1 dwelling branch is unresolved and is not invented.
Common-area and garage/irrigation services are omitted from this first model. Unit 106 is a continuation only; Unit 107 is the detailed dwelling.

Plant arrangement and reduced device detail are illustrative. Safety relief/drain piping, flues, detailed controls and balancing bypasses are not fully modeled. WAC2 is a loose spare, not a second installed pump.
Unit A island underfloor path is assumed between annotated drops. Dishwasher connection is unresolved and omitted. Hot/return joins are depicted at representative loop endpoints.
Annotations in the supplied PDF are treated as review information, not proof of installed conditions.

Bathroom pilot hardware is representative: five fixture stops, two mixing bodies, flexible connectors, elbows and tees are not a verified fitting/product schedule. Purple identifies mixed-water outlets without asserting temperature or valve performance.

Bathroom lavatory and toilet drops have assumed wall-side offsets behind the fixture envelopes. Overhead services are assumed at CW 102 in, HW 100 in, HWC 98 in; the local service offsets are not covered by the ±6 in source-trace allowance.
